label.zh: 科学家返回：被“终末”吞没的星系
label.en: Scientist Returns: a galaxy lost to the End

note.zh: 探索者回到被“终末”吞没的星系，立即获得“精神创伤”和“裂隙扭曲”特质。每个国家只会看到一次。
note.en: The explorer returns to a galaxy lost to the End and at once gains the Traumatized and Rift Warped traits. Each empire sees this only once.

notes.zh: 触发：on_astral_rift_exploration_complete（00_on_actions.txt:5013）。条件：国家带有标记 end_of_the_cycle_reckoning（“终结周期”危机中帝国被毁后，由该危机的事件设置）且尚未出现过本事件（astral_planes_210_happened）。设置该标记的事件不在本类别内。
notes.en: Trigger: on_astral_rift_exploration_complete (00_on_actions.txt:5013). Conditions: the country has the flag end_of_the_cycle_reckoning (set by events of the End of the Cycle crisis after the empire was destroyed) and has not had this event (astral_planes_210_happened). The events that set that flag are outside this category.

scope.zh: 已核对 astral_planes.210 及其 on_action 条目；未追查设置 end_of_the_cycle_reckoning 的危机事件（不属于 C4）。
scope.en: Checked astral_planes.210 and its on_action entry; the crisis events that set end_of_the_cycle_reckoning were not traced (outside C4).

uncertain: end_of_the_cycle_reckoning 的设置位置未核对。 / Where end_of_the_cycle_reckoning is set was not checked.
